findings.name: gpu-carveout-write
findings.detail: NOT a source bug -- intentional alternative boot path: ['LUMA.DAT', 'ORBITAL.DAT'] are BAREMETAL demo payloads loaded only by the separate U-Boot bootmenu alternatives 'prodockboot luma' / 'prodockboot orbital' (config.h bootmenu_1 line 9 / bootmenu_2 line 10), never simultaneously with Linux: the menu default (bootmenu_0 'prodockboot linux') loads LINUX.BIN only, and the U-Boot image() helper runs for exactly ONE selected menu entry.  Their windows sit in external DDR3 (the region linux/manifest.json gpu_memory [8388608, 92274688] later reserves as framebuffer/asset memory), NOT in any 'GPU SRAM'. Recorded as an intentional alternative path in this offline, file-only audit; no image build, no hardware, no board qualification performed.
